children: Overview
UK battery storage fund's half-year NAV per share rose 15.8% to 131.30p
Portfolio revenues up 9.5% and EBITDA up 14.5% from H1 2025
Revenue per operational MW fell due to weaker merchant environment and asset downtime for upgrades
Outlook
Company targets £141 mln annualised EBITDA once new projects and Alternative Revenue strategy are operational
Company expects Alternative Revenues capacity to reach at least 20MW by end-2026
Company maintains target of £25 mln incremental annual EBITDA from Alternative Revenues strategy
Result Drivers
PROJECT REVALUATION - NAV per share increase was mainly driven by revaluation of 397MW of projects now under construction on a discounted cash flow basis
OPERATIONAL CAPACITY - Revenue growth was primarily driven by increased operational MW capacity, despite some assets being offline for augmentation works
CONTRACTED REVENUES - Proportion of contracted revenues increased to 61%, reducing portfolio risk
